item.title: Cold weather isn't cooling down Mardi Gras in Denham Springs
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS &mdash; Despite freezing temperatures in the forecast, the Krewe of Denham Springs says its Mardi Gras parade is still rolling this weekend.Forecasters expect highs to remain in the 30s on Saturday, a sharp contrast from last year, when temperatures climbed into the 60s. Still, organizers say cold weather won&rsquo;t stop the celebration.As crews put the finishing touches on parade floats, Krewe of Denham Springs officials say spirits remain high.&ldquo;Everyone&rsquo;s still in.

item.title: Right lane blocked on I-12 East at Airline Highway exit due to flipped car
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; The right lane of I-12 East and the exit ramp from I-12 East to U.S. 61 N. are blocked due to a flipped car.The crash happened around 8:50 p.m. DOTD cameras show the car flipped upside down.EMS is on the scene; there is no information on injuries at this time.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.description: PONCHATOULA &mdash; A man accused of biting off a portion of a woman's face has been located and is in custody, the Tangipahoa Parish Sheriff's Office said.&nbsp;Brandon Patrick, 31, was taken into custody on Friday night, three days after an alleged domestic dispute where Patrick reportedly held the victim against her will for several hours.
